notes.title: [Patch 1.1] - Miglioramenti generali grazie alla community!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are excited to announce the release of Patch 1.1 for Show Yourself! We have listened to the feedback from our community and have been working hard to improve the game experience. Here is what's new in this version:

- Adjustable Brightness: We have added a brightness slider! You can now adjust the game's brightness to suit your preferences and game conditions.
- Fullscreen Mode: Finally, the game is fully supported in fullscreen, for an even more immersive experience.
- Dialogue Fix: We have fixed a small error in one of the dialogues to ensure that every scene is as expected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45530669/cfea73980ec13f0ee22a560f0b2bfd822220328e.png[/img]

Other Improvements:
- Performance optimizations to ensure better stability.
- Several minor UI improvements for smoother navigation.

Thank you for your continued support! Your feedback is essential to improving the game, so keep it coming!

If you haven't already, don't forget to leave a review on Steam and let us know what you think of this new patch!

...and that's not all! While we wait for new reports, we’re cooking up exciting new games for the future. Thanks for the support!

Thanks and have fun!

notes.title: Game release date announced!
notes.notes: We're excited to announce [b]the release dates[/b] for the Show Yourself Director's Cut demo and full game, along with the launch trailer: the demo will be available on April 18th, and the full game on May 2nd!

notes.title: The game's release is near!
notes.notes:
We are getting closer and closer to the official launch of Show Yourself!

And for the occasion, we are happy to announce the arrival of a free demo that will allow you to immediately enter the heart of the experience.

What does the demo contain?
– The first 3 levels of the full game, with all the mechanics and atmospheres that define the soul of the adventure.
– A special level, also present in the full game but absent in previous versions that you may have tried elsewhere. Perhaps it is the scariest part of all of Show Yourself...

If you like what you see, add the game to your wishlist and share it with your friends: with your support, we could really bring it to Game Pass, making the experience accessible to more and more people.

Thank you for being part of this journey💙
– The WattyGames team
